steps: toolchain=`sed -n 's/^KERNEL_RUST_TOOLCHAIN=//p' $(ROOT)/.config | tr -d '"' | tail -n1`; if grep -qx 'DRIVER_XHCI=y' $(ROOT)/.config; then cargo "+$toolchain" build --offline -Z build-std=core,alloc,compiler_builtins -Z json-target-spec --release --target $(ROOT)/services/core/x86_64-unknown-mochios.json --target-dir $(OUT)/services-build/target --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/mnu\".mnu-abi.path='$(ROOT)/core/crates/abi'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-platform.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/platform'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-runtime.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/runtime'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-syscall.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/syscall'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochios-capability-protocol.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/capability-protocol'" --manifest-path $(PROJECT)/usb-driver/Cargo.toml -p usb-driver --bin entry; fi

toolchain=`sed -n 's/^KERNEL_RUST_TOOLCHAIN=//p' $(ROOT)/.config | tr -d '"' | tail -n1`; if grep -qx 'DRIVER_I8042=y' $(ROOT)/.config; then cargo "+$toolchain" build --offline -Z build-std=core,alloc,compiler_builtins -Z json-target-spec --release --target $(ROOT)/services/core/x86_64-unknown-mochios.json --target-dir $(OUT)/services-build/target --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/mnu\".mnu-abi.path='$(ROOT)/core/crates/abi'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-platform.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/platform'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-runtime.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/runtime'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-syscall.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/syscall'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochios-capability-protocol.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/capability-protocol'" --manifest-path $(PROJECT)/ps2/i8042-driver/Cargo.toml -p i8042-driver --bin i8042-entry; fi

toolchain=`sed -n 's/^KERNEL_RUST_TOOLCHAIN=//p' $(ROOT)/.config | tr -d '"' | tail -n1`; if grep -qx 'DRIVER_VIRTIO_NET=y' $(ROOT)/.config; then cargo "+$toolchain" build --offline -Z build-std=core,alloc,compiler_builtins -Z json-target-spec --release --target $(ROOT)/services/core/x86_64-unknown-mochios.json --target-dir $(OUT)/services-build/target --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/mnu\".mnu-abi.path='$(ROOT)/core/crates/abi'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-platform.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/platform'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-runtime.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/runtime'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochi-user-syscall.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/syscall'" --config "patch.\"https://github.com/mochiOS/syscalls\".mochios-capability-protocol.path='$(ROOT)/user/crates/capability-protocol'" --manifest-path $(PROJECT)/virtio-net-driver/Cargo.toml -p virtio-net-driver --bin virtio-net-driver; fi
